addictionPotential: 无成瘾性且滥用潜力低。
summary: 一种流行且强力的迷幻剂，通常有两种使用方式：蒸发吸入以获得短暂的“突破”体验，或与酶抑制剂合用以获得长时间强烈旅行（也称 ayahuasca 或 pharmahuasca）。
effectsSummary: Intense visual and auditory hallucinations, ego dissolution, out-of-body experiences, breakthrough into alternative realities. Onset is extremely rapid and duration is short.
dosageRemark: DMT is not active orally unless combined with an MAOI. Vaporization/injection provides rapid onset.
generalRisks: Extreme psychological reactions, panic, fear. Temporary increase in blood pressure. Risk of HPPD.
longtermRisks: No research results on long-term risks. HPPD is rare. Main risk is psychological distress during the experience.
saferUse: Always have a trip sitter present.
Have a safe and comfortable setting.
